name: Reverie Movies
original_description:
Create AI videos, cinematic short films, music videos and animated stories with Reverie Movies.

Turn an idea, screenplay or song into a complete film. Develop concepts, build storyboards, create consistent characters, generate cinematic video clips and assemble them into a finished movie.

Go beyond individual AI video clips with connected shots, visual continuity, character references, video extension, AI editing, lip-sync, voiceovers, sound effects and timeline-based filmmaking.

Reverie picks the right video model for each shot, or you can choose one yourself.

Requires a Reverie Movies account.
